name: Enoki Mushroom
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated in SIBO protocols as they're low in fermentable carbohydrates and contain beneficial prebiotic compounds in small amounts.
preparationTips: Trim off the tough root end before using
Separate individual mushrooms gently to avoid breaking
Add to soups and stir-fries in the last few minutes of cooking
Can be eaten raw in salads for a crisp texture
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of B vitamins, especially niacin
